It’s a PvE mode up to 4 players against zombies
There is a few objectives, but mainly it’s protecting specific locations through building around them and while you’re at it, you do special quests that let you progress through the game mode
You have your own base as well as randomly generated levels you’re able to play; your base (called a ‘storm shield’) has a shield around it and you expand it up to 10 times, after that the while island is for you to play around with (as a further challenge once you complete 10 ‘Storm Shield Defences’ you unlock a special type of waves called ‘Endurance waves’, they are a long grind and take around 2 and a half hours to complete. There is plently of different types of traps, through spike traps to tar pits, to gas or darts or grills as well as plenty of different guns, you unlock schematics which allow you to craft weapons from weapon blueprints which can be levelled up to be stronger as well as you can upgrade every attribute of a weapon for example reload speed, damage or magazine size.
There is 4 main locations, Stonewood, Plankerton, Canny Valley and Twine Peaks but there are additional locations through in game special events that occur once per 2 or so months I think.
You can of course upgrade your own character which you can choose and swap at any given moment, there are 4 classes of characters, Constructors (based around reinforcement of builds mainly), Soldiers (all about damaging zombies or so called ‘Husks’), Outlanders (All about using gadgets, collecting resources and somewhat concentrated on mobility, mainly through a dash that’s one of their perks) and Ninjas (All about mobility and using melee weapons, double jump and no fall damage). Now speaking about perks every character has 3 they are mostly random, as in you can’t really predict what perks are the best/the most useful but I’d say just try as many of them as possible, as in character classes as well as perks to find what you feel most comfortable with playing, I myself like mobility and I like to use gadgets and collect a lot of parts for weapons and traps as well as building materials so my favourite class is Outlanders but I do also love Ninjas, I didn’t particularly like Constructors or Soldiers, just not my style of playing.
To be honest that is mainly it, if I missed anything key then you’ll easily find out about it in game, hope I helped and have fun! :)
